description: This file defines a class and functions for loading and running inference with ONNX models using the onnxruntime library.

classes.name: OnnxModel
classes.description: A data class encapsulating an ONNX Runtime inference session, input name, and output names.

methods.name: OnnxModel load_onnx_model(path: str, preferred_providers: list[str] | None = None)
methods.description: Loads an ONNX model from a given file path, with optional preferred providers, returning an OnnxModel instance.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] run_onnx(model: OnnxModel, x: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Runs inference on the provided ONNX model with the given input numpy array, returning a dictionary of output names to arrays.

ctags.name: load_onnx_model
ctags.pattern: /^def load_onnx_model(path: str, preferred_providers: list[str] | None = None) -> OnnxModel:$/

ctags.name: run_onnx
ctags.pattern: /^def run_onnx(model: OnnxModel, x: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:$/
